title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Scientific Literature
abstract: Retrieval augmented generation combines document retrieval with a language model. The study reports that retrieved evidence can ground answers and reduce unsupported generation when the evidence is relevant.

title: Vector Retrieval and Language Models
abstract: Dense vector retrieval maps queries and documents into an embedding space. Language models can use the retrieved documents as context. The paper argues that retrieval quality strongly influences downstream answer quality.

title: Version-Aware Scientific Search
abstract: Scientific papers can have multiple versions. A research search system should retain version metadata and prefer the latest known version when the user asks for current evidence, while preserving earlier versions for auditability.

title: Retrieval Set Size Does Not Always Improve Answer Quality
abstract: In a controlled experiment, increasing the retrieval set beyond a moderate size sometimes introduced distractors and reduced answer quality. The authors recommend selecting evidence carefully rather than assuming more documents are always better.

title: Large Retrieval Sets Improve Scientific Question Answering
abstract: This study reports that, for its benchmark, larger retrieval sets improved recall and sometimes improved final answer quality. The authors caution that the result depends on retrieval quality and the downstream model.

title: Uncertainty-Aware Literature Question Answering
abstract: A literature QA system should abstain when retrieved evidence is insufficient. The authors evaluate evidence coverage and show that explicit uncertainty statements are preferable to confident unsupported answers.

title: Scientific Literature Reproduction Search
abstract: Reproduction questions are multi-step research tasks. A system may need to identify the original claim, search for later studies, compare methods and outcomes, and report whether evidence supports or contradicts the original result.

title: Unrelated Astronomy Dataset
abstract: This paper studies stellar spectra and galaxy observations. It does not discuss retrieval augmented generation, vector databases, literature QA, or research-paper search.
